description: The engagement's open-items register — the things the close can't yet account for (a document not received, a term not found in the agreement, an unmatched figure). List them, open a new one, or resolve one by id. The register ships alongside the certified figures; no gap is ever filled on the client's behalf, and the close cannot be signed while any item remains open.

action.description: list (default), open a new item, or resolve one.

engagement_id.description: The engagement whose register to act on.

item.description: For action=open: the open item's description.

item_id.description: For action=resolve: the id of the item being resolved.

owner.description: For action=open: who owns resolving it.

name: open_items
